subnetPicker.helper: Leave this empty and Docker picks one from the pool. Choose one to control how much address space the network uses.
subnetPicker.poolUsed: This pool is {{percent}}% used. A smaller subnet keeps more room.

tasks.label: Expected tasks
tasks.helper: Optional. Coaming recommends the smallest size that fits twice this number, plus service and node addresses and headroom.
tasks.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000.
tasks.tooMany: {{n}} tasks need more than a /24 holds. Split the work across more than one network.

how.body: Addresses needed = (2 × tasks + services + nodes) × 1.25, rounded up, plus 3 reserved. Twice the tasks covers a start-first update, where old and new tasks run together. Services is the number of services on the network (1 when unknown). Nodes is the number of nodes that can run its tasks (0 on a standalone host).

subnet.label: Subnet
subnet.hostBits: {{subnet}} has host bits set. Did you mean {{network}}?
subnet.tooSmall: A subnet smaller than /29 can't hold a gateway and any containers.

suggest.name: Suggest a free subnet of the chosen size
suggest.needsNode: Choose a node first. A local network gets its subnet from that node's pools.
suggest.noFree: No free /{{mask}} block is left in {{pool}}. Try a smaller size, free up space first, or plan a bigger pool.
suggest.error: Couldn't suggest a subnet. Type one, or try again.

check.error: Couldn't check this subnet. You can still create the network.
check.ipv6: IPv6 subnets aren't checked for overlaps.

findings.label: Subnet check
findings.sameEnv: Overlaps {{network}} ({{subnet}}). Docker can't tell the two networks apart.
findings.sameEnvOnNode: Overlaps {{network}} ({{subnet}}) on {{node}}. Docker can't tell the two networks apart.
findings.otherEnv: Overlaps {{network}} ({{subnet}}) on {{environment}}. This only matters if the two sites are routed or joined by a VPN.
findings.hostRoute: Overlaps a route on {{node}}: {{route}} on {{iface}}. Traffic to that range may go to the network instead of the container.
findings.outsidePool: Outside the address pool {{pool}}. Docker allows it, but it won't count toward the pool's usage.

routes.oldAgent: update the agent to check host routes.
routes.unmounted: the agent can't read the host's routes. Mount the route file (see the agent install).
routes.unmountedFixName: the command that adds the route mount
routes.unmountedStandalone: Re-run the agent install command from this environment's settings to add the mount.
routes.local: Coaming's container can't read this host's routes. Add -v /proc/1/net/route:/host/route:ro to Coaming's docker run.
routes.failed: the agent's answer couldn't be read.

createAnyway.label: Create it anyway
createAnyway.helper: Some setups, such as macvlan, share a range on purpose. Coaming records that you chose this.
createAnyway.blocked: Resolve the overlap, or tick Create it anyway.

errors.overlapRefused: Another network in this environment overlaps this subnet. Resolve the overlap, or tick Create it anyway.
